full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the instant Rule, in a nut-shell, as has been stated in the revisional application are that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted Other Suit No.65 of 1995 for partition, the suit schedule properties are situated within Mithanala and Maijpatti Moms of Hathazari Police Station. The suit schedules 'Ka', `Kha' and `Ga' were the properties of Saibba Prasanna by purchase, settlement by Patta as well as by deed of partition being deed No.402 dated 10.02.1951 and also purchased land of their father Rebati Raman Das by Deed No.2288 dated 14.11.1940; the suit B.S. Khatian No.610, Plot No.1029 corresponding to R.S. Khatian No.468 P.S. Khatian No.545, Plot No.406 are homestead originally inherited property of their father Rebati Raman Das. In the homestead land one co-sharer Gagan Chandra gifted his share to his daughter Sarna Prova Das by Deed dated 20.12.1928 who in her turn sold out 1 Gonda, 1 Kara to Saibba Prasanna Das by Deed No.1956 dated 10.4.1957. Both the plaintiff and defendant No, l's father gifted this property to their mother, the schedule `Ka' land belonged to the plaintiff's mother and recorded in her name in B.S. Khatian although wrongly some names have been recorded in B.S. Khatian along with her, but she was in exclusive possession therein and by those wrong entry in B.S. Khatian her title had never been interrupted. The schedule `Kha' land belonged to the plaintiff's mother and Joshna Mayee in equal share and B.S. Khatian has been recorded accordingly. In schedule `Ga' plaintiff's mother was the owner of .37 decimals of land and her name has been recorded accordingly in B.S. Khatian along with other co-sharers. The schedule `Gal belonged to the plaintiff and defendant No.1 by purchase deed dated 12.4.1958 and 24.5.1963 and their mother paid consideration money accordingly, but defendant No.1 being eldest brother was trusted to get registry purchase deed, but he intentionally got registered 2 separate purchase deeds mentioning maximum land in his deed, but both the parties are possessing the same equally and the B.S. Khatian has been recorded accordingly. The plaintiff maintained livelihood of his mother and took care of her, therefore, she being satisfied gifted schedule lima' land to the plaintiff by Deed No.3717 dated 31 .12.1991 and related title deed was handed over to him, thus the plaintiff has become the only owner of schedule 'lima' land and that the plaintiff's mother died on 21.4.1992 leaving him and defendant No. 1 as her heirs. After the death of mother dispute has arisen between the plaintiff and defendant No.1 relating to the landed properties and in I' week of September, 1992 the defendant No.1 disclosed that mother has gifted some property to him in the year 1990 and asked the plaintiff to leave the homestead land otherwise he will be forcibly evicted and then on search the Fatimabad Sub-Registry Office the plaintiff came to know on 9.9.1993 regarding the said forged gift deed dated 19.9.1990 through one Haripada Das Munshi. The plaintiff or his mother was not owner of the said gift deed property. The mother did not gift any land to the defendant No. 1. The plaintiff possessing the Northern portion and defendant No.1 possessing the southern portion of the homestead land, but in the forged deed of gift the homestead, the plaintiffs purchased personal land including third parties property have been included. Although his mother had no right to do so. Three months before of the death of the plaintiffs mother a salish was taken place between the plaintiff and defendant No.1 for partition and the defendant No. 1 declined to accept the said salish. But in that salish the defendant No.1 did not disclose anything regarding the alleged gift deed. Then the plaintiff filed a case for partition before the Village Court and the defendant No. 1 contested the same by filing written-statement, but the Village Court took the view that the case for partition is beyond its jurisdiction and asked them to seek remedy before the Civil Court and the village Court case was ended without any decision. Thereafter the defendant No. l along with his unruly son and others physically tortured the plaintiff upon which Hathazari P.S. Case No. 6 (2)94 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 16 of 1994 has been filed and the same is pending for trial. The alleged gift deed dated 19.9.1990 is illegal, forged, fabricated, concocted, and inoperative.
